name: Reactive Gastronomy
description: Field Chef Elandrial seeks high-energy ingredients.|Elandrial believes combining volatile ingredients with crafted components can produce combat-grade ration tech. Gather the materials and prove the protocol.
rewards: Experience in Cooking, Fletching, and Power Control

text: Seeker, I've heard you're versatile in the field.
I have a theory that fusing elemental properties in food can create something extraordinary.
First, I need you to explore the Frozen Caves to find the Icecap Mushroom.
But be wary, the caves are known to be treacherous!

hasItemText: Perfect! Now, for the next ingredient.
We need an arrow with fiery properties. But not just any arrow, an arrow crafted with the Feather of a Phoenix.
You'll need to use your fletching skills to craft this arrow.
completedText: Combine the Phoenix Feather with an arrow shaft.
Once you've crafted the Fiery Phoenix Arrow,

hasItemText: Magnificent! Now, for the final touch, we will calibrate this arrow with a lift protocol.
Use your control training to run a levitation protocol on this arrow.
It will become the Levitating Fiery Phoenix Arrow!
completedText: Craft the Levitating Fiery Phoenix Arrow.
Once calibrated, return to me with the arrow.
We're close to completing the dish!

hasItemText: This is it, Seeker! Final step.
Now, using your cooking skills, combine the Icecap Mushroom and the Levitating Fiery Phoenix Arrow.
The result will be a dish never seen before!

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Reactive Gastronomy@green@. You've been awarded a @crimson@Reactive Dish@green@ and experience in Cooking, Fletching, and Power Control!
